events.title: Raagrang (2nd Edition) by Nibaddh Foundation
events.description: A 2nd edition classical music evening featuring a classical vocal recital by Pt. Suresh Gandharv Ji, a santoor recital by Abhay Sopori Ji, and tabla accompaniment, with a book inauguration on solo tabla vadan by Dr. Deepak Dabhade. The event is held in loving memory of Ustad Iqbal Ahmed Khan.
events.venue: India International Centre, Multipurpose Hall, Max Mueller Marg, Delhi - 110003
events.notes: Seats are first come first served. Chief guest: Vidushi Krishna Bisht (SNA Awardee).
